intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** Maintained proof detects a supplier title lookup that loses the story anchor when two suppliers share a seed.

Story: `SEED-342#follow-story-references-by-title`, checked at `726de30444471bd59858e76867fa8e84d527a934`. The selected promise is key example 4: suppliers sharing a seed show their own titles and open their own stories in the correct project.

One scratch fault changed `titleOf` in `dashboard/src/StoryCardDependencies.tsx:98` from matching the complete recorded identity to matching only `identity.split("#")[0]`. Fixtures and assertions stayed intact. `suppliersInOneSeed` and the real dependency publication supplied separate `#b` and `#second` stories.

The same maintained command ran for baseline, fault and restoration:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- dashboard/tests/stories/story-dependencies.spec.ts --grep 'two suppliers sharing one seed' --workers=1
```

Baseline passed (exit 0); matching list output enumerated exactly one test. The faulted run selected that one test and failed. The actual catch was the first title-selected href assertion at `story-dependencies.spec.ts:209`: its exact `Story B` link locator resolved to two links. The retained page snapshot independently shows both `B.md#b` and `B.md#second` labeled `Story B`; the second should be `Second story in seed B`. This establishes wrong rendered behavior on the exercised path, rather than an unrelated timeout or merely executed faulty code. Evidence survives at `/tmp/seed342-ic-fault-error-context.md` (snapshot lines 93–94 and 128–129), `/tmp/seed342-ic-fault.log`, and `/tmp/seed342-ic-fault-trace.zip`.

An exit trap restored the original source bytes. `cmp` verified the original file and the complete pre/post Git status matched (both clean), then the same focused command passed after restoration, with one selected test and no retry. Proof records: `/tmp/seed342-ic-fault-proof.json` and `/tmp/seed342-ic-restored-proof.json`. The isolated detached scratch worktree `/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-342-title-lookup` was created at the checked revision, prepared with locked `npm ci`, restored, and removed successfully. The execution checkout was not edited.

Next proof action: retain the existing same-seed integration assertion; this observed fault needs no new assertion or repair. No prior repair or disposition is being treated as a new decision from this probe. The conclusion covers this active-supplier title ambiguity, not all other story promises.
